functions.Time: lambda g, r: sum([g._adj[r[idx]][r[idx + 1]].get('cost', '') for idx in range(len(r) - 1)])
functions.Distance: lambda g, r: sum([g._adj[r[idx]][r[idx + 1]].get('distance', '') for idx in range(len(r) - 1)])
functions.Station Name: lambda g, r: [g._node[r].get('name', '') for r in r]
functions.City: lambda g, r: [g._node[r].get('city', '') for r in r]
functions.State: lambda g, r: [g._node[r].get('state', '') for r in r]
functions.ZIP: lambda g, r: [g._node[r].get('zip', '') for r in r]
functions.Longitude: lambda g, r: [g._node[r].get('x', '') for r in r]
functions.Latitude: lambda g, r: [g._node[r].get('y', '') for r in r]
functions.DCFC: lambda g, r: [g._node[r].get('dcfc', '') for r in r]
functions.Network: lambda g, r: [g._node[r].get('network', '') for r in r]
functions.DAC/LIC: lambda g, r: [g._node[r].get('dac_lic', '') for r in r]
functions.Connector: lambda g, r: [g._node[r].get('connector', '') for r in r]
functions.AC Chargers: lambda g, r: [np.nanmax([0, g._node[r].get('n_ac', 0)]) for r in r]
functions.DC Chargers: lambda g, r: [np.nanmax([0, g._node[r].get('n_dc', 0)]) for r in r]
